title: Bernie Young's WPA band in Milwaukee
summary: He joins Bernie Young's WPA band in Milwaukee, finds its members just draw pay and do not work.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: So anyway, I got a letter from this guy named Bernie Young in Milwaukee. I had met this saxophone player, and he had told me about Bernie Young, and I sounded him, you know, if he could get me a job, I'd come and join the band. So he said for me to come on and join the band. That was another mistake! Because they were on the WPA, do you know what that is?

Yeah. See, all of the band was on that. So when I joined it, I went there, they didn't give a shit about working. You know, they was workin' anyway! So I'm there, and I ain't got no money and I ain't got no job... I mean, I got a job but they don't work!
